summary_en: OPI・IT Holdings will acquire all outstanding shares of Internetworking and Broadband Consulting (IBC) at 1,490 yen per share through a tender offer from November 12 to December 24, 2026. The minimum acquisition target is 2,508,200 shares (66.67% ownership post-acquisition), resulting in IBC's delisting from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
title_en: Notice of Statement of Support and Recommendation to Apply for Tender Offer for Company Shares by OPI・IT Holdings Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, IBC's board of directors approved and recommended to shareholders a tender offer by OPI・IT Holdings Co., Ltd. for all outstanding shares of the company. The offer price is set at 1,490 yen per share, with a minimum acquisition target of 2,508,200 shares. Following the acquisition of these shares, OPI・IT Holdings will hold approximately 66.67% of IBC, establishing it as a wholly owned subsidiary.

The tender offer period runs for 30 business days, from November 12 through December 24, 2026. Upon successful completion of the offer and related procedures, IBC is expected to be delisted from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market. The board's approval was based on the benefits of becoming part of the OPI・IT Holdings group. OPI・IT Holdings is itself a 100%-owned subsidiary of OPI2002 Investment Partnership, which is affiliated with Orix Corporation through its ownership of H.C. Networks Co., Ltd. There is minimal existing business relationship between IBC and these entities, limited to several annual product sales transactions.
